destin.reason: Open Town view on Destin Harbor Boardwalk, HarborWalk Marina and Emerald Grande; preserve the mapped district anchor.

port-st-joe.reason: George Core Park brings the Cape San Blas lighthouse, marina and St. Joseph Bay into one frame.

apalachicola.reason: The downtown riverfront frames the brick storefronts, historic warehouses and working-waterfront docks.

st-george-island.reason: The lighthouse anchors the island’s pastel cottages and Gulf beach.

carrabelle.reason: The city dock frames Carrabelle’s riverfront fishing town, marinas and compact main street.

st-marks.reason: The river park puts the river junction, historic fort and boating waterfront together.

st-teresa.reason: The Wilson Beach shoreline frames St. Teresa’s wooded beachfront homes and quiet bay water.

mexico-beach.reason: The fishing canal and marina frame Mexico Beach’s low-rise streets and nearby Gulf beach.
